howto.what: 当你需要故障艺术风格的视频标题或转场帧时，Claude 会生成一个 16:9 的赛博朋克标题帧，包含彩色偏移文字、扫描线、噪点及数据腐败伪影，可定制标题和副标题。

howto.what_en: When you need a glitch-themed video title or transition frame, Claude will generate a 16:9 cyberpunk title frame with RGB offset, scanlines, noise, and data corruption artifacts, customizable with your own title and subtitle.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a 'glitch title', 'cyberpunk title', or a title frame for video transitions.

say_en.text: Make me a cyberpunk-style video title with glitch effects.
say_en.note: Claude produces a 16:9 glitch title frame.

say_en.text: Generate a digital glitch title frame for a video transition.
say_en.note: Result includes scanlines, color shift, and noise.
